questions.question: What was the simple average day-ahead price at CAISO's SP15 hub in October 2026, in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The simple average day-ahead price at CAISO's SP15 hub (TH_SP15_GEN-APND) for October 2026 was 46.78 USD/MWh (iso_trader_daily, derived). It is the mean of the 31 daily day-ahead means (da_mean_usd) for the local operating days 1-31 October 2026, Pacific time. All 31 days are held. I did not use cost_of_power_monthly for this. Its October row (da_simple_mean 47.556 USD/MWh) covers only 48 day-ahead hours, about 2 days, so it is not the full month.

The warehouse therefore has no average for that day, and I give no figure.

questions.question: What was the average hourly day-ahead price at ERCOT's hub average (HB_HUBAVG) in the week of Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (Central time), in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The full week is not in the warehouse, so I can't give a figure for it. The day-ahead table (iso_dam_hub_prices, ERCOT HB_HUBAVG, variable spp_dam) holds only 120 of the 168 hours in Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (Central time). The 48 hours from 12 am Central on Saturday 7 November to the end of Sunday 8 November are missing, and nothing is filled in. Over the 120 hours it does hold, 2 to 6 November, the mean is 39.24 USD/MWh (iso_dam_hub_prices, source table). That is a mean of 120 hourly day-ahead prices, not the whole week's figure. The daily means in that window run from 26.99 USD/MWh on 5 November to 58.98 USD/MWh on 3 November. The derived table ercot_hub_prices_daily gives the same 39.24 USD/MWh over 2 to 6 November, and it has no rows for 7 and 8 November either.

questions.question: What was the average hourly nuclear generation in the Lower 48 states in the week of Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (UTC), in MW?
questions.answer: The warehouse holds only part of that week, so I can't give a whole-week average. Hourly nuclear generation for the Lower 48 (eia930:US48, net_generation_nuclear_mw) is held for 72 of the 168 hours from Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (UTC). The held hours are 2 to 4 November. Over those 72 hours the mean is 79,920.44 MW (eia930_all_generation, source table). The other 96 hours, 5 to 8 November, are not held, and nothing was filled in. The figure covers Monday to Wednesday only and should not be read as the week's average.
